item.title: Iconic designer Bob Mackie dies at 87. See photos of legendary stars he dressed.
item.description: Dubbed the "Designer to the Stars," Bob Mackie won nine Emmy Awards, a Tony Award and was nominated for three Oscars.

item.title: What are the monthly payments on a $250,000 home equity loan if opened this September?
item.description: Need to borrow $250,000 from your home equity? Here's how much a loan can cost if taken out in today's rate climate.

item.title: The U.S. economy faces mounting headwinds. Here are the top risks.
item.description: Rising energy costs, persistently high inflation and mounting federal debt are clouding the outlook for the U.S. economy — and Americans' finances.

item.title: Trump blames rising diesel price on Russia-Ukraine war
item.description: President Trump said on social media that the rising diesel price is mostly due to the Russia-Ukraine war and not Iran. CBS News' Aidan Stretch has more.

item.title: Trump dismisses AI leaders' warnings, slams Anthropic CEO in social media post
item.description: President Trump downplayed recent warnings from leaders of major AI firms about tech regulation and development. In a post on Truth Social, he accused Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei of "pretending to be a 'perfect little angel.'" CBS News' Caitlin Huey-Burns has more.

item.title: Extended interview: Stella Parton
item.description: Stella Parton offers fans a glimpse into the life of her larger-than-life sister, Dolly Parton, from her makeup routine to her views on death, in an exclusive interview with "CBS Mornings" co-host Gayle King.

item.title: Oil prices near 4-month high as Iran and Oman delay Strait of Hormuz talks
item.description: Iran and Oman delay a meeting to discuss control of the Strait of Hormuz as fighting between Iran's Houthi allies and Saudi Arabia raises the stakes for global energy markets.

item.title: Vance says 870K people suspected of COVID-era US fraud barred from federal loans
item.description: A U.S. enforcement push, dubbed "Heartland fraud surge," probed losses involving the Paycheck Protection Program and Economic Injury Disaster Loan program.

item.title: What a Fed rate hike could mean for gold and silver prices
item.description: Gold and silver prices are under pressure right now, and this week's Fed decision could determine what comes next.

item.title: Trump dismisses push for AI guardrails despite warnings from tech leaders
item.description: President Trump threw cold water on momentum for AI guardrails, saying all the U.S. needs is a "SMART PRESIDENT."

item.title: Don Jr.'s wife says Russian oligarch hosted post-wedding festivities as a "gift"
item.description: Bettina Anderson, wife of Donald Trump Jr., said their "dear friend" Umar Kremlev hosted two nights of festivities after their wedding in the Bahamas.

item.title: Saudi Arabia's critical pipeline remains shut as oil prices soar
item.description: The East-West pipeline in Saudi Arabia remains shut after a drone attack last week, a major hit to the supply of oil flowing out of the country. Saudi Arabia blamed the attack on Iranian-backed militias in Iraq. Threadneedle founder Ann Berry joins to discuss.

item.title: After losing son, couple welcomes daughter born from embryo frozen for 22 years
item.description: The couple named their daughter Georgia in honor of their late son, Giorgos.

item.title: Maine's head prison chief on giving inmates second chances: "I believe in redemption"
item.description: This installment of "Beg-Knows America" features Randall Liberty, the commissioner of the Maine Department of Corrections, whose own family influenced his belief and efforts in providing inmates with education, employment, training and dignity.

item.title: Tech stocks slump after AI execs call for industry slowdown
item.description: The Nasdaq slid 1% on Monday after AI company executives called for a slowdown in developing the technology.

item.title: Democrats have edge in seats in fight for House, CBS News poll shows
item.description: Both Republicans and Democrats see the midterms as being about President Trump. A new CBS News poll finds prices and inflation are driving voter sentiment in 2026 against the party in power, just as they did two years ago.

item.title: A history-making game to open the NFL season
item.description: The Chicago Bears beat the Carolina Panthers 59-37, making it the highest-scoring Week 1 game in NFL history. Chris Branch, senior writer for The Athletic, breaks down the unbelievable game, and other highlights from the weekend.

item.title: Is $40,000 in credit card debt too much for a consolidation loan?
item.description: A high credit card balance can change the debt consolidation equation, but does it put this option out of reach?

item.title: AI warnings from tech CEOs are a "wake-up call," financial expert says
item.description: Bill Cohen, author of "Money to Burn," reacts to new warnings from major tech CEOs about AI and calls to slow the pace of development. "I'd take this warning very seriously," he told CBS News 24/7.

item.title: How Trump and lawmakers are responding to CEOs call for AI slowdown
item.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei warned that AI development is at a turning point and urged a slowdown, a call that OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Elon Musk agreed on. President Trump, however, downplayed the AI leaders' warning. CBS News' Aaron Navarro and Taurean Small have more.

item.title: As AI rhetoric heats up, Congress stalls on action
item.description: Some House Democrats are calling on Speaker Mike Johnson to delay the congressional recess expected at the end of the week until lawmakers pass AI safeguards.

item.title: Air Force officer shot down in Iran says he was grateful watching crewmate get rescued
item.description: The Air Force colonel who spent two days evading capture after Iran shot down his F-15E sat down with Norah O'Donnell in a 60 Minutes interview. The airman recalled the moment he saw his fellow crewmate being saved as he hid. CBS News national security analyst Aaron Maclean joins to share what stood out to him in the interview.

item.title: Even with Rams a Super Bowl favorite, coach Sean McVay is "tormented"
item.description: With the Rams a Super Bowl favorite as the season kicks off, coach Sean McVay is forging ahead, having learned from past successes and failures.

item.title: About Us
item.description: "60 Minutes" airs Sundays at 7 p.m. ET/PT

item.title: Pardon brokers offer to "put pressure on the president," at sky-high costs
item.description: Hidden cameras captured lobbyists as they tried to woo a potential client interested in obtaining a pardon from President Trump.

item.title: Air Force officer prayed while "free-falling" after being shot down in Iran
item.description: Badly wounded and alone in Iran's desert, downed U.S. Air Force officer Dude 44 Bravo evaded capture for days as the Iranian forces and the U.S. military searched for him.

item.title: Alexander Zverev wins U.S. Open, beating American Ben Shelton
item.description: Germany's Alexander Zverev won his second Grand Slam after finally taking home his first major title earlier this year at the French Open.

item.title: Scientists still identifying 9/11 victims' remains | 60 Minutes Archive
item.description: It's been 25 years since 9/11, and the New York City Office of Chief Medical Examiner continues its pledge to identify remains for as long as there are families looking for answers.

item.title: Stefany Shaheen says "time is up on the Trump administration" after winning House primary
item.description: While New Hampshire Democratic Sen. Jeanne Shaheen is not seeking reelection, her daughter is hoping she can carry the torch forward after prevailing Tuesday night in the Democratic primary for the state's First Congressional District. Stefany Shaheen joins "The Takeout" to unpack her win and discuss what comes next.

item.title: Legendary fashion designer Bob Mackie reflects on his decades-long career
item.description: Fashion and costume designer Bob Mackie has dressed stars, including Cher and Tina Turner. Recently, Taylor Swift wore one of Mackie's decades-old creations.
